subject: catalog-cleanup
title: Same product, two prices: a sample two-store catalog check
description:
A walk through a sample two-store ecommerce catalog cleanup for an invented linen shop: issues by product, price and stock differences between stores, and proposed fixes.

Product Catalog Cleanup and Cross-Store Check: a pilot offer from Amber One. The sample uses an invented business and invented data. A person reviews every report before it goes to you. Narrated with a synthetic voice.

#ecommerce #productcatalog

See the sample report and the pilot terms: https://hq.amberoneai.com/offers/catalog-cleanup?src=youtube&utm_campaign=catalog-cleanup-sample-walkthrough
narration: Selling on your own store and a marketplace? Your listings drift apart.
In this sample, two stores' exports were compared. Five differences turned up between them, like a price that doesn't match.
It also catches messy SKUs, missing fields, and barcodes that fail the check-digit test.
Every fix is a proposal you apply yourself. Nothing is changed in your stores, and there are no pricing decisions.
The full sample is at the link below.
